title: Implement product-spec inventory compiler
goal: Compile the canonical product specification into a deterministic machine-readable inventory without redefining product semantics.
why_now: Autonomous planning and completeness checks require a generated index of canonical product obligations and references.
required_capabilities: strictly inventory active markdown files and front-matter identity fields
extract known CMDR identifier references without treating prose as new product truth
support check mode that fails on stale generated inventory
definition_of_done: inventory output is deterministic across identical trees
generated index records source path and source hash
tests cover front matter parsing, duplicate detection and deterministic ordering
CI verifies generated inventory is current
